engines.name: Bing Search
engines.description: Scrape Bing web search results in JSON, including organic results, ads, inline videos and related searches. Supports location, market, country and date/display filters.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Search query. Supports Bing operators such as NOT, OR, site:, filetype:, near:, ip:, loc:, feed:.

params.name: location
params.label: Location
params.help: Where the search originates; city level recommended. Use SerpApi's locations.json API for precise control.

params.name: lat
params.label: Latitude
params.help: GPS latitude of the search origin.

params.name: lon
params.label: Longitude
params.help: GPS longitude of the search origin.

params.name: mkt
params.label: Market
params.help: Market in the form <language code>-<country code>, e.g. en-US (case insensitive). Bing recommends always specifying it. Mutually exclusive with cc where cc is available. Codes: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/bing/search-apis/bing-web-search/reference/market-codes

params.name: cc
params.label: Country code
params.help: Two-character ISO 3166-1 country code to search from (e.g. us, de, gb). Mutually exclusive with mkt.

params.name: first
params.label: Result offset
params.help: Offset of organic results; defaults to 1 (first=10 moves the 10th result to first position).

params.name: safeSearch
params.label: Safe search
params.help: Adult content filtering. Off: adult text, images and videos allowed; Moderate: adult text allowed but not adult images/videos; Strict: no adult content.

params.name: filters
params.label: Advanced filters
params.help: Complex Bing filters such as date range ex1:"ez5_18169_18230" or display filters; copy the exact value from the `filters` query parameter of a Bing search URL.

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device used to fetch results: desktop (default, regular browser), tablet (iPads) or mobile.

pagination.notes: first=1 is the first result; there is no documented page-size parameter.

engines.aira_use: Research target employers, interview topics and salary pages on Bing, which often surfaces different results from Google.

engines.name: Extract
engines.description: Extract structured JSON or Markdown from any public web page: page info, meta tags, structured data, headings, links, images, text, with scrape, map and crawl modes.

params.name: url
params.label: Page URL
params.help: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to extract. Search pages with a dedicated SerpApi engine are redirected to that engine.

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.help: scrape (single page, default), map (list website URLs from links and sitemaps), crawl (follow same-site links; one credit per page).

params.name: max_pages
params.label: Max pages
params.help: Crawl mode: maximum pages to extract including the start page (default 10, max 100).

params.name: max_depth
params.label: Max depth
params.help: Crawl mode: link depth from the start page (default 2, max 3; 0 only the start page).

params.name: include_subdomains
params.label: Include subdomains
params.help: Map and crawl modes: include other subdomains of the same site. Default false.

params.name: include_sitemap
params.label: Include sitemap
params.help: Map mode: also read /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt. Default true.

params.name: prefetch_delay
params.label: Prefetch delay (ms)
params.help: Delay in ms before the first fetch (0-10,000, default 0). Not a JS rendering delay.

params.name: timeout
params.label: Timeout (ms)
params.help: HTTP request timeout in ms (1,000-120,000, default 30,000).

params.name: include_tags
params.label: Include tags
params.help: Comma-separated CSS selectors to keep (e.g. article, main, .post-content).

params.name: exclude_tags
params.label: Exclude tags
params.help: Comma-separated CSS selectors to remove before parsing (e.g. nav, footer, .ads).

params.name: include_markdown
params.label: Include Markdown
params.help: Add main content as Markdown in text_content.markdown. Default false.

params.name: include_inline_assets
params.label: Include inline assets
params.help: Include inline style and script blocks with content. Default false.

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device used to fetch results: desktop (default, regular browser), tablet (iPads) or mobile.

pagination.notes: Crawl mode uses max_pages instead of pagination.
